related_condition: Engineering plant safety / standing risk-control measure
control: Maintain enhanced engineering-plant tag-out verification during propulsion and electrical plant maintenance. The Engineering Officer of the Watch shall review all tags affecting propulsion, electrical distribution, or firemain configuration before work begins.

Require Combat Information Center watch supervisors to verify time synchronization of designated tactical systems at watch turnover and before major training events. Document significant discrepancies in the applicable watch log.
Maintain a daily temperature log for all walk-in refrigerated and frozen food-storage spaces. Notify Supply and Engineering leadership of temperatures outside established food-storage limits.

Conduct an additional sounding and visual inspection of designated auxiliary machinery-space bilges during each duty-section round. Report abnormal fluid accumulation or evidence of leakage to the Engineering Officer of the Watch.

Prohibit unauthorized changes to tactical-network fiber routing, console connections, or approved system baseline configurations without Combat Systems Officer approval and documented restoration checks.

Require bridge and CIC navigation watch teams to conduct and log a cross-check of primary heading, position, and surface-contact data before entering restricted waters or commencing sea-and-anchor detail.

When conducting firemain maintenance, maintain at least one verified alternate firefighting-water path before isolating a firemain section. Brief the damage-control watchstander on all temporary firemain lineups.

Maintain a manual tactical data-link status board in CIC during major exercises, restricted-emissions periods, and casualty-response drills. Update the board at watch turnover and upon material configuration changes.

Inventory and inspect galley critical-equipment spare parts monthly, including heating elements, pumps, belts, refrigeration controls, and sanitation-system components. Report below-minimum stock to the Supply Officer.
Restrict GTM 1A operation to no more than 85 percent power. Do not conduct high-power runs pending vibration assessment and repair.
Secure Auxiliary Steam Line No. 2. Prohibit operation or maintenance that introduces pressure to the affected line until the relief-line gasket is replaced and leak tested.
Disable AN/SPY-1D high-power transmit mode. Operate in approved reduced-power configuration only and log all signal-processor faults.
Secure AN/SLQ-32(V)6 active transmitters. Maintain passive receive capability as available; do not energize transmit functions pending cooling-water flow-switch replacement.

related_condition: Mk 45 Mod 2 Gun Mount / CASREP C2-26-051
control: Operate the Mk 45 gun mount using a single-hoist feed rate only. Do not conduct sustained-fire or rapid-feed evolutions until the lower-hoist sensing switch is aligned and tested.
Maintain a dedicated surface-search radar watch at CIC Console No. 2 whenever AN/SPS-73 is energized. Cross-check bearing data against available navigation sources.
